tasks.title: Link store
tasks.spec: src/store.js: createLink(url) returns { code, url } with a 6-character base62 code and throws on invalid URLs (only http and https). getLink(code) returns the link or null. recordVisit(code, { ip, at }) stores a visit. getVisits(code) returns the visits for a code. Keep everything in memory.

tasks.title: Redirect
tasks.spec: src/redirect.js: resolve(code, ip) returns the target URL and records a visit with the ip and the current time, or returns null for an unknown code. Use the store from src/store.js.

tasks.title: Stats
tasks.spec: src/stats.js: stats(code) returns { hits, lastVisit } for a code, where hits is the number of visits and lastVisit is the time of the latest visit or null. Use getVisits from src/store.js.

tasks.title: HTTP API
tasks.spec: src/server.js: createServer() returns a node:http server. POST /links with JSON { url } returns 201 { code }. GET /:code redirects with 302 to the URL, or 404. GET /links/:code/stats returns 200 with the stats JSON, or 404. Tests start the server on port 0.
